label: Jyutping sounds
desc: One character per sound point: the Jyutping letters English readers misread (j, z, c, ng-, gw, aa / a, eo, oe, yu, final -p -t -k, syllabic m and ng)

label: Tone twins
desc: Same letters, different tone, different word: 詩 史 試 時 市 事, 買 / 賣, 四 / 死, 係 / 喺

label: First characters
desc: Pictures and compounds to recognise: 人 口 日 月 山 水 木 林 明 好 休, and the 口 that marks spoken-Cantonese characters

label: Greetings and courtesy
desc: Hello, the two thank-yous 唔該 and 多謝, sorry, goodbye and good night

label: People and family
desc: Pronouns with 哋, family members on both sides, and friends

label: About me
desc: Name, nationality, where you live, languages, and small talk about yourself

label: Numbers and money
desc: Numbers to ten thousand and beyond, 兩 and 二, and prices in 蚊

label: Classifiers
desc: Number, this / that or owner + classifier + noun: 個, 本, 杯, 張, 隻, 部, 架

label: Food and drink
desc: Dim sum, the cha chaan teng (Hong Kong café), drinks, and ordering and paying

label: Shopping
desc: Prices, sizes, a little bargaining, and paying by Octopus card

label: Time, days and dates
desc: Clock time, days of the week, dates, today and tomorrow, and parts of the day

label: Around town and directions
desc: Where things are, left and right, across and next to, and asking the way

label: Getting around
desc: The MTR, buses and minibuses, taxis, ferries, the Octopus card and tickets

label: Work and study
desc: Jobs, school, learning Cantonese, and what you can and know how to do

label: Health and help
desc: Feeling sick, the pharmacy, the doctor, and asking for help

label: Describing things
desc: Adjectives for people, food, weather and prices, with 好, 太, 幾 and comparisons with 過

label: Questions and particles
desc: Question words, A-not-A questions, and the sentence-final particles 呀, 啦, 吖, 呢, 㗎

label: Traps for English speakers
desc: False friends and calques: 係 with adjectives, 唔有, 二個, 咗 and 過, 唔該 or 多謝, and greetings that are not what they seem

label: Top nouns
desc: The most-used everyday nouns, with the measure word they take: 時間, 錢, 屋企, 地方, 電話

label: Top verbs
desc: The most-used verbs: 講, 話, 做, 食, 睇, 知, 想, 要, 嚟, 識

label: Top adjectives
desc: Describing words, which work like verbs and take no 係: 靚, 多, 新, 高, 快, 攰, 開心

label: Top adverbs
desc: Before the verb: 都, 就, 仲, 先, 再, 太, 最, 已經, 成日, 而家

label: Top pronouns
desc: 你, 佢, 自己, 大家, mine and yours with 嘅, this and that, who, what and where

label: Top coverbs and place words
desc: What Cantonese uses instead of prepositions: 同, 畀, 幫, 用, 對, and place words like 入面, 隔籬, 對面

label: Top conjunctions
desc: 同埋, 但係, 不過, 因為, 所以, 如果, 或者, 定係, 然後

label: Top interjections
desc: What people really exclaim: 好嘢！ 死喇！ 係咩？ 唔係嘛！ 加油！

label: Top words
desc: Numbers to twenty, question words, yes and no, this year, today and the days of the week

label: Top measure words
desc: The measure words not yet taught on their own: 個, 隻, 本, 張, 條, 件, 位, 間, 碗, 次, 啲

label: Top particles
desc: Sentence-final 呀, 啦, 喎, 囉, 咩, 㗎, 呢 and the aspect markers 緊, 過, 住

label: Flirting
desc: Words people flirt with, the phrases built from them, asking someone out, and kind ways to say yes or no

label: Compliments
desc: Praising food, work, homes and kids, and the modest ways Hong Kong people answer praise
